project_type: Local tournament dashboard ('Brawl Hockey', Doomsday theme). Python stdlib http.server backend + pure-Python engine + vanilla JS/CSS/HTML frontend. No third-party runtime deps.
language: Python 3.9 (backend/engine) and vanilla ES (browser JS, no build step)
build_system: None. Static assets served directly from static/ by app.py (python3 app.py). No bundler, no package.json.
test_framework: Python unittest (tests/test_*.py, 44 tests) and a Node vm-sandbox UI test (tests/test_ui.cjs, run with node). An optional Playwright real-browser test (tests/test_browser.cjs) is NOT required and needs network/Playwright.
build_command:
No build. To run live: python3 app.py --no-browser --port

--data /tmp/t.json
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && node tests/test_ui.cjs
verification_instructions: 1) python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v  (expect ~44 OK). 2) node tests/test_ui.cjs (expect exit 0, all section lines print). 3) Live probe via a script FILE under /projects/sandbox that starts the server, curls /, /app.js, /style.css, then kills it (ONE bash invocation; backgrounded servers die across bash calls; the server-start guard trips on literal port/host flags typed in the command string, so put them in a script file).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. tournament.json is runtime data (gitignored). No snapshot/generated checked-in files.
setup_instructions: No setup/install needed. python3 and node are preinstalled (python3 3.9.25, node v22). Just edit static/* and run the two test commands.
environment_constraints: Backgrounded processes do not survive across separate execute_bash calls (fresh PID namespace each call) - start+probe+kill the live server in ONE invocation using a script file. A server-start guard also trips on literal port/host flags typed directly in a command string, so put app.py flags inside a script FILE. No network needed for the required work; do NOT add external assets/fonts/audio/libraries.
contribution_requirements: No third-party deps. Keep schema version 4. Old backups must still load. Keep all Python + UI tests green. Frontend/UX-only: engine.py and app.py should NOT need changes (data about who is cut/advances already comes from the engine view). Respect prefers-reduced-motion and the Pause-world toggle. Shake must stay OFF content/dialogs.
key_patterns: static/index.html has a full-screen apocalyptic backdrop <div id='world' class='world' aria-hidden='true'> containing an SVG .world-scene with gradients incl url(#fire) and animated groups (.explosion, .smoke, .flight.missile-*, .crashing-plane, .embers). The Pause-world control is #world-toggle (class .world-toggle, aria-pressed) handled by worldClick(e) in app.js, which toggles document.body.classList 'world-paused'. CSS '.world-paused .world *' sets animation-play-state:paused (also .inside-room, .page-hidden). reducedMotion() helper = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches. There is a @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) CSS block. Web Animations API (el.animate([...],{...})) and requestAnimationFrame are already used (wheel spin, openMatchResult, openScreen). TWO dialogs: #screen-dialog (room zoom) and #result-dialog (per-match popup + end-of-round fullscreen). End-of-round flow: openMatchResult(key,match) sets resultFinal=(match===meta.count-1)&&v.games.every(g=>g.ready); renderResult() routes resultPopup vs resultFullscreen; closeResult() closes. stageMeta={round1:{count:5,label:'To Live'},round2:{count:8,label:'To Die'},final:{count:10,label:'Rebirth'}}. The eliminated-names source: view.round1.rows/view.round2.rows have {id,name,rank,status} with status 'ADVANCE'/'CUT'/'TIE'; view.final.rows have status 'FINAL'/'TIE' with rank/prize (non-podium = rank>3). view[key].complete is true only when the round is settled (no outstanding TIE). So cut players: round1 -> rows status 'CUT'; round2 -> rows status 'CUT'; final -> rows rank>3. ONLY play the cutscene when resultFinal AND view[key].complete (no unresolved tie).
relevant_files: static/index.html  (world layer, #world-toggle, dialogs; add cutscene overlay root + furnace SVG defs if needed)
static/style.css   (world + reduced-motion keyframes/blocks; add ambient blast, world-only shake, and cutscene styles; honor .world-paused and prefers-reduced-motion)

static/app.js      (worldClick toggle, reducedMotion(), openMatchResult/renderResult/closeResult, requestAnimationFrame + el.animate patterns; add ambient explosion/nuke loop gated by pause+reduced-motion, world-layer-only shake, and the three-round skippable furnace cutscene)

tests/test_ui.cjs  (vm sandbox + fetch stub + click() helper; matchMedia currently returns {matches:true}. Extend to assert cutscene trigger per stage with exactly correct eliminated names, no-trigger on non-final / unresolved tie, skippable dismiss, reduced-motion static summary, and ambient loop start/stop gated by pause+reduced-motion)
README.md          (document the new ambient effects + cutscene briefly if other features are documented there)
directory_structure: app.py (HTTP server, 97 lines), engine.py (pure-Python tournament logic, 533 lines), static/{index.html,app.js,style.css} (the entire frontend), tests/{test_tournament.py,test_regressions.py,test_goal_limits.py (Python unittest), test_ui.cjs (Node vm UI test), test_browser.cjs (optional Playwright)}, tournament.json (runtime data, gitignored), start.bat, README.md.
